batches_unit_with_quantity.name: batches_unit_with_quantity
batches_unit_with_quantity.value: "batches"."quantity" IS NULL OR "batches"."unit" IS NOT NULL

batches_match_state.name: batches_match_state
batches_match_state.value: ("batches"."unmatched" AND "batches"."ingredient_id" IS NULL AND "batches"."raw_name" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "batches"."unmatched" AND "batches"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL)

recipe_ingredient_lines_matched_or_named.name: recipe_ingredient_lines_matched_or_named
recipe_ingredient_lines_matched_or_named.value: ("recipe_ingredient_lines"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("recipe_ingredient_lines"."raw_name" IS NOT NULL AND "recipe_ingredient_lines"."normalized_name" IS NOT NULL)

recipes_minutes_non_negative.name: recipes_minutes_non_negative
recipes_minutes_non_negative.value: ("recipes"."prep_minutes" IS NULL OR "recipes"."prep_minutes" >= 0) AND ("recipes"."cook_minutes" IS NULL OR "recipes"."cook_minutes" >= 0)

shopping_items_matched_or_named.name: shopping_items_matched_or_named
shopping_items_matched_or_named.value: ("shopping_items"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("shopping_items"."name" IS NOT NULL)

shopping_template_lines_matched_or_named.name: shopping_template_lines_matched_or_named
shopping_template_lines_matched_or_named.value: ("shopping_template_lines"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("shopping_template_lines"."name" IS NOT NULL)

staples_unit_with_quantity.name: staples_unit_with_quantity
staples_unit_with_quantity.value: "staples"."quantity" IS NULL OR "staples"."unit" IS NOT NULL
